svg.aria-label: Persistence overlay of all captured frames
svg.text: Measured waveforms only. No decoding. Darkness = fraction of frames with the carrier on at that instant.
crisp: 20 address bits identical in every frame
crisp end to end: one button always sends exactly the same 32 bits
The blur is the entire finding. Wherever the ten buttons disagree, the overlay goes grey, and that happens
only in the last 12 bits. That is the command field, located without decoding a single bit.
